messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": ["dark glossy segmented armor covering the back, neck, shoulders, hips and lower legs", "dark head cap with a long curved barbed horn"], "description": "A large four-legged quadruped with the head, small rounded ears, shaggy brown fur, thick legs and broad clawed paws of a brown bear, covered over the back, neck, shoulders, hips and lower legs with glossy dark brown-black segmented plates resembling a beetle exoskeleton, and with a matching dark cap on the head bearing a single long curved barbed horn projecting forward.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with muzzle and dark nose", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded brown furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the top sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy dark beetle horn with small barbs curving forward", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head rising from the dark head plate"}, {"looks_like": "thick brown furry bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad brown furry bear paws with long claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown-black segmented beetle exoskeleton", "part": "plates", "where": "covering the top of the head, neck, back, shoulders, hips and lower legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 0, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
